items.title: This is placeholder digest data
items.why: Run scripts/fetch_digest.py (or the GitHub Action) to replace this with real ranked items.

items.title: Add your RSS feeds first
items.why: The feed list in scripts/fetch_digest.py is empty by default — fill it in before the digest becomes useful.

items.title: Digest refreshes once daily
items.why: The GitHub Actions workflow runs the script on a schedule and commits the updated file.
